summary.title: Multiverse Computing, a pioneer in AI and quantum computing, keeps its shareholder register in Sttok

features.value: Shareholder register, transaction simulator and documents

texts: Multiverse Computing is a San Sebastián company specialised in artificial intelligence and quantum computing, and the leader in AI model compression. CB Insights named it one of the 100 most promising AI companies in the world in 2025.
A company growing at this pace, with international funding rounds, needs a flawless shareholder register.

uses.title: A flawless shareholder register
uses.text: Each investor with their shares, their class and their history.

uses.title: Rounds, before they are signed
uses.text: The effect of each capital increase on the cap table, simulated before closing.

uses.title: Deeds read with AI
uses.text: Each transaction is recorded from its deed.
